concepts.definition: an Arabic noun or nominal word that names a person, place, thing, quality, or idea
an Arabic verb expressing an action or state and normally associated with tense
an Arabic particle whose grammatical meaning is completed through its relationship with other words
an Arabic sentence or complete grammatical construction that communicates a meaning
the masculine grammatical gender used for appropriate Arabic nouns and agreement forms
the feminine grammatical gender used for appropriate Arabic nouns and agreement forms
the singular grammatical form referring to one person or thing
the dual grammatical form referring to exactly two persons or things
the plural grammatical form referring to more than two persons or things
a verb form used to express an action regarded as completed before the present moment
